# 2. PRODUCTIVITY CLASSIFICATION
# ============================================================

classify_productivity <- function(planned, actual, distraction, focus) {
  
  if (is.na(planned) || planned == 0) return("Moderate")
  completion <- actual / planned
  
  if (completion >= 0.80 && distraction <= 1.5 && focus >= 4) {
    return("High")
  } else if (completion < 0.50 || distraction > 3 || focus <= 2) {
    return("Low")
  } else {
    return("Moderate")
  }
}


# ============================================================
# 3. DEFAULT TRANSITION MATRIX
# ============================================================

default_matrix <- function() {
  
  P <- matrix(
    c(
      0.65, 0.30, 0.05,
      0.30, 0.50, 0.20,
      0.15, 0.35, 0.50
    ),
    nrow = 3,
    byrow = TRUE
  )
  
  rownames(P) <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  colnames(P) <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  
  return(P)
}


# ============================================================
# 4. ESTIMATE TRANSITION MATRIX FROM HISTORY
# ============================================================

estimate_matrix <- function(states, dates = NULL) {

  P <- matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
  rownames(P) <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  colnames(P) <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")

  if (length(states) < 2 || all(is.na(states))) {
    return(default_matrix())
  }

  # If dates are supplied, only treat consecutive calendar days as
  # one-step transitions. A gap in the log is not silently treated
  # as a one-day transition.
  for (i in 1:(length(states) - 1)) {

    if (!is.null(dates)) {
      if (is.na(dates[i]) || is.na(dates[i + 1]) ||
          as.integer(dates[i + 1] - dates[i]) != 1) {
        next
      }
    }

    from <- match(states[i], rownames(P))
    to   <- match(states[i + 1], colnames(P))

    if (!is.na(from) && !is.na(to)) {
      P[from, to] <- P[from, to] + 1
    }
  }

  fallback <- default_matrix()

  for (i in 1:3) {
    row_total <- sum(P[i, ])

    if (row_total > 0) {
      P[i, ] <- P[i, ] / row_total
    } else {
      P[i, ] <- fallback[i, ]
    }
  }

  P
}


# ============================================================
# 5. STATIONARY DISTRIBUTION
# ============================================================

stationary_distribution <- function(P) {

  # Guard against numerical drift.
  P <- pmax(P, 0)
  row_sums <- rowSums(P)
  for (i in 1:nrow(P)) {
    if (row_sums[i] > 0) P[i, ] <- P[i, ] / row_sums[i]
  }

  # Solve pi P = pi subject to sum(pi) = 1.
  # This is more direct than relying only on repeated iteration.
  A <- t(P) - diag(3)
  A[3, ] <- 1
  b <- c(0, 0, 1)

  result <- tryCatch(as.numeric(solve(A, b)), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (!is.null(result) && all(is.finite(result))) {
    result <- pmax(result, 0)
    total <- sum(result)
    if (total > 0) return(result / total)
  }

  # Fallback for numerically awkward/reducible cases.
  pi_vec <- c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3)

  for (i in 1:10000) {
    new_pi <- as.numeric(pi_vec %*% P)

    if (max(abs(new_pi - pi_vec)) < 0.0000001) {
      return(new_pi / sum(new_pi))
    }

    pi_vec <- new_pi
  }

  pi_vec / sum(pi_vec)
}

            div(class="theory-box",
              h4("One-step transition probability"),

            p("↓"),

          )
        )

    )
  )

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  storage_key <- "actuarial_prep_tracker_v5"
  data_store <- reactiveVal(study_data)

  normalize_data <- function(d) {
    if (is.null(d) || !is.data.frame(d)) return(study_data)
    needed <- names(study_data)
    for (nm in setdiff(needed, names(d))) {
      if (nm == "Entry_ID" || nm %in% c("Exam","Topic","State")) d[[nm]] <- character(nrow(d)) else if (nm == "Date") d[[nm]] <- as.Date(NA) else d[[nm]] <- numeric(nrow(d))
    }
    d <- d[, needed, drop=FALSE]
    d$Entry_ID <- as.character(d$Entry_ID)
    if (any(is.na(d$Entry_ID)) || any(d$Entry_ID == "")) {
      missing <- is.na(d$Entry_ID) | d$Entry_ID == ""
      d$Entry_ID[missing] <- paste0("E", format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d%H%M%S"), "_", seq_len(sum(missing)))
    }
    d$Date <- as.Date(d$Date)
    for (nm in c("Planned_Hours","Study_Hours","Sessions","Breaks","Distraction_Hours","Sleep_Hours","Focus","Problems_Attempted","Problems_Correct","Mock_Score")) d[[nm]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[nm]]))
    d$Exam <- as.character(d$Exam); d$Topic <- as.character(d$Topic); d$State <- as.character(d$State)
    d <- d[!is.na(d$Date), , drop=FALSE]
    rownames(d) <- NULL
    d
  }

  persist_data <- function(d) {
    payload <- jsonlite::toJSON(d, dataframe="rows", na="null", auto_unbox=TRUE)
    session$sendCustomMessage("save_tracker_data", list(key=storage_key, data=payload))
  }

  observeEvent(input$stored_data, {
    raw <- input$stored_data
    if (is.null(raw) || identical(raw, "")) return()
    loaded <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(raw, simplifyDataFrame=TRUE), error=function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(loaded)) {
      loaded <- normalize_data(as.data.frame(loaded, stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
      data_store(loaded)
      showNotification(paste("Restored", nrow(loaded), "saved session", ifelse(nrow(loaded)==1,"","s"), "from this browser."), type="message", duration=4)
    }
  }, once=TRUE)

  # Top dropdown navigation
  observeEvent(input$top_nav, {
    req(input$top_nav)
    session$sendCustomMessage("show_page", input$top_nav)
  }, ignoreInit = FALSE)

  observeEvent(input$go_log, {
    session$sendCustomMessage("show_page", "log")
  })

  # Client-side page switching handler is defined below in UI via custom message.

  observeEvent(input$exam, { updateSelectInput(session,"topic",choices=topics_by_exam[[input$exam]]) })

  current_state <- reactive({ classify_productivity(input$planned,input$actual,input$distraction,input$focus) })

  output$live_state <- renderUI({
    state <- current_state()
    cls <- if(state=="High") "status-high" else if(state=="Moderate") "status-moderate" else "status-low"
    icon <- if(state=="High") "🟢" else if(state=="Moderate") "🟡" else "🔴"
    msg <- if(state=="High") "Excellent study session — keep that momentum." else if(state=="Moderate") "Reasonable progress. Look at the factors affecting consistency." else "Use this session as information, not judgement."
    div(class=cls,div(class="status-title",paste(icon,state,"productivity")),p(msg,style="margin:6px 0 0;color:#686579;"))
  })

  output$daily_summary <- renderTable({
    completion <- if(input$planned>0) input$actual/input$planned*100 else 0
    accuracy <- if(!is.na(input$problems_attempted) && input$problems_attempted>0) round(input$problems_correct/input$problems_attempted*100,1) else NA
    data.frame(Measure=c("Exam","Topic","Planned","Actual","Completion","Sessions","Problems","Correct","Accuracy","Mock","Distraction","Sleep","Focus","Productivity"),Value=c(input$exam,input$topic,paste0(input$planned," h"),paste0(input$actual," h"),paste0(round(completion,1),"%"),input$sessions,input$problems_attempted,input$problems_correct,ifelse(is.na(accuracy),"-",paste0(accuracy,"%")),ifelse(is.na(input$mock_score),"-",paste0(input$mock_score,"%")),paste0(input$distraction," h"),paste0(input$sleep," h"),paste0(input$focus,"/5"),current_state()))
  }, striped=TRUE,bordered=FALSE)

  observeEvent(input$save, {
    req(input$date,input$exam,input$topic)

    if (is.na(input$problems_attempted) || input$problems_attempted < 0 ||
        is.na(input$problems_correct) || input$problems_correct < 0) {
      showNotification("Problem counts must be non-negative.", type="error")
      return()
    }

    if (input$problems_correct > input$problems_attempted) {
      showNotification("Problems correct cannot exceed problems attempted.", type="error")
      return()
    }

    new_row <- data.frame(
      Entry_ID=paste0("E",format(Sys.time(),"%Y%m%d%H%M%S"),"_",sample(1000:9999,1)),
      Date=as.Date(input$date), Exam=input$exam, Topic=input$topic,
      Planned_Hours=input$planned, Study_Hours=input$actual, Sessions=input$sessions, Breaks=input$breaks,
      Distraction_Hours=input$distraction, Sleep_Hours=input$sleep, Focus=input$focus,
      Problems_Attempted=input$problems_attempted, Problems_Correct=input$problems_correct,
      Mock_Score=input$mock_score, State=current_state(), stringsAsFactors=FALSE
    )
    new_data <- rbind(data_store(),new_row)
    new_data <- normalize_data(new_data)
    new_data <- new_data[order(new_data$Date,new_data$Entry_ID),,drop=FALSE]
    data_store(new_data); persist_data(new_data)
    showNotification(paste("Saved",current_state(),"productivity session for",input$exam),type="message")
  })

  output$history <- renderTable({
    d <- data_store(); if(nrow(d)==0) return(data.frame(Message="No study sessions yet."))
    d <- d[order(d$Date,d$Entry_ID,decreasing=TRUE),]
    accuracy <- ifelse(!is.na(d$Problems_Attempted)&d$Problems_Attempted>0,paste0(round(d$Problems_Correct/d$Problems_Attempted*100,1),"%"),"-")
    data.frame(ID=substring(d$Entry_ID,1,12),Date=format(d$Date,"%d %b %Y"),Exam=d$Exam,Topic=d$Topic,Planned=paste0(d$Planned_Hours," h"),Studied=paste0(d$Study_Hours," h"),Problems=paste0(d$Problems_Correct,"/",d$Problems_Attempted),Accuracy=accuracy,Mock=ifelse(is.na(d$Mock_Score),"-",paste0(d$Mock_Score,"%")),Focus=paste0(d$Focus,"/5"),State=d$State)
  },striped=TRUE,bordered=FALSE)

  observe({
    d <- data_store()
    if(nrow(d)==0) updateSelectInput(session,"delete_entry",choices=character(0)) else {
      d <- d[order(d$Date,d$Entry_ID,decreasing=TRUE),]
      labels <- paste(format(d$Date,"%d %b %Y"),"·",d$Exam,"·",d$Topic,"·",d$Study_Hours,"h")
      updateSelectInput(session,"delete_entry",choices=setNames(d$Entry_ID,labels))
    }
  })

  observeEvent(input$delete_selected, {
    req(input$delete_entry)
    d <- data_store(); target <- input$delete_entry; removed <- d[d$Entry_ID==target,,drop=FALSE]
    d <- d[d$Entry_ID!=target,,drop=FALSE]; data_store(d); persist_data(d)
    if(nrow(removed)>0) showNotification(paste("Deleted",removed$Exam,"·",removed$Topic),type="warning")
  })

  observeEvent(input$clear_all, {
    if(isTRUE(input$confirm_clear_all)) {
      data_store(study_data); persist_data(study_data); session$sendCustomMessage("clear_tracker_data",list(key=storage_key)); updateCheckboxInput(session,"confirm_clear_all",value=FALSE); showNotification("All history cleared.",type="warning")
    } else showNotification("Check the confirmation box first.",type="error")
  })

  observeEvent(input$import_file, {
    req(input$import_file$datapath)
    imported <- tryCatch(read.csv(input$import_file$datapath,stringsAsFactors=FALSE,check.names=FALSE),error=function(e) NULL)
    if(is.null(imported)) { showNotification("Could not read that CSV.",type="error"); return() }
    imported <- normalize_data(imported)
    if(nrow(imported)==0) { showNotification("The CSV contains no usable study rows.",type="error"); return() }
    data_store(imported); persist_data(imported); showNotification(paste("Imported",nrow(imported),"study sessions."),type="message")
  })

  # Use one state per date for Markov calculations so multiple sessions on one day
  # do not artificially overweight a single calendar day.
  daily_data <- reactive({
    d <- data_store()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      return(data.frame(Date=as.Date(character()), State=character(), stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
    }

    d <- d[order(d$Date, d$Entry_ID), , drop=FALSE]

    # One productivity state per calendar day: use the final session logged that day.
    daily <- d[!duplicated(d$Date, fromLast=TRUE), c("Date","State"), drop=FALSE]
    daily[order(daily$Date), , drop=FALSE]
  })

  daily_states <- reactive({ daily_data()$State })
  daily_dates  <- reactive({ daily_data()$Date })

  P <- reactive({ estimate_matrix(daily_states(), daily_dates()) })
  output$matrix <- renderTable({round(P(),3)},rownames=TRUE)
  output$matrix_warning <- renderUI({
    d <- daily_data()
    n_days <- nrow(d)
    n_transitions <- if (n_days < 2) 0 else sum(as.integer(diff(d$Date)) == 1)

    if (n_transitions < 15) {
      div(class="small-note",
          paste0("⚠ ", n_days, " logged days and ", n_transitions,
                 " consecutive-day transitions. More consecutive daily observations will improve matrix stability."))
    } else {
      div(class="small-note",
          paste0("✓ Matrix estimated from ", n_transitions,
                 " consecutive-day transitions across ", n_days, " logged days."))
    }
  })

  output$latest_state <- renderText({ d<-data_store(); if(nrow(d)==0) "No logs yet" else tail(d[order(d$Date,d$Entry_ID),]$State,1) })
  output$latest_hours <- renderText({ d<-data_store(); if(nrow(d)==0) "0 h" else paste0(tail(d[order(d$Date,d$Entry_ID),]$Study_Hours,1)," h") })

  tomorrow_probabilities <- reactive({ d<-daily_states(); if(length(d)==0) return(c(High=1/3,Moderate=1/3,Low=1/3)); row<-match(tail(d,1),c("High","Moderate","Low")); P()[row,] })
  output$tomorrow_state <- renderText({ c("High","Moderate","Low")[which.max(tomorrow_probabilities())] })
  output$high_chance <- renderText({paste0(round(tomorrow_probabilities()[1]*100,1),"%")})

  output$productivity_plot <- renderPlot({
    d<-data_store(); if(nrow(d)==0){plot.new();text(.5,.5,"No study data logged yet.");return()}; d<-d[order(d$Date,d$Entry_ID),]; daily<-d[!duplicated(d$Date,fromLast=TRUE),]; y<-match(daily$State,c("Low","Moderate","High")); plot(daily$Date,y,type="o",pch=19,lwd=2,ylim=c(1,3),yaxt="n",xlab="Date",ylab="Productivity"); axis(2,at=1:3,labels=c("Low","Moderate","High")); grid()
  })

  output$hours_plot <- renderPlot({
    d<-data_store(); if(nrow(d)==0){plot.new();text(.5,.5,"No study data logged yet.");return()}; agg<-aggregate(cbind(Planned_Hours,Study_Hours)~Date,data=d,FUN=sum,na.rm=TRUE); agg<-agg[order(agg$Date),]; ylim<-range(c(agg$Planned_Hours,agg$Study_Hours,0)); plot(agg$Date,agg$Planned_Hours,type="o",pch=19,lwd=2,xlab="Date",ylab="Hours",ylim=ylim); lines(agg$Date,agg$Study_Hours,type="o",pch=19,lwd=3); legend("topleft",legend=c("Planned","Actual"),lwd=c(2,3),bty="n"); grid()
  })

  output$matrix_plot <- renderPlot({barplot(t(P()),beside=TRUE,names.arg=c("High","Moderate","Low"),ylim=c(0,1),ylab="Probability",xlab="Today's State",legend.text=c("High tomorrow","Moderate tomorrow","Low tomorrow"),args.legend=list(x="topright",bty="n"));grid(nx=NA,ny=NULL)})

  forecast <- reactive({ current<-if(length(daily_states())==0) 2 else match(tail(daily_states(),1),c("High","Moderate","Low")); result<-matrix(0,15,3);result[1,current]<-1;for(i in 2:15)result[i,]<-result[i-1,]%*%P();data.frame(Day=0:14,High=result[,1],Moderate=result[,2],Low=result[,3]) })
  output$forecast_message <- renderUI({probs<-tomorrow_probabilities();states<-c("High","Moderate","Low");best<-which.max(probs);div(class=if(states[best]=="High")"status-high" else if(states[best]=="Moderate")"status-moderate" else "status-low",div(class="status-title",paste("Tomorrow is most likely:",states[best])),p(paste0(round(probs[best]*100,1),"% probability")))})
  output$forecast_plot <- renderPlot({d<-forecast();plot(d$Day,d$High,type="l",lwd=3,ylim=c(0,1),xlab="Days ahead",ylab="Probability");lines(d$Day,d$Moderate,lwd=3,lty=2);lines(d$Day,d$Low,lwd=3,lty=3);legend("right",legend=c("High","Moderate","Low"),lty=1:3,lwd=3,bty="n");grid()})
  stationary <- reactive({stationary_distribution(P())})
  output$stationary_table <- renderTable({s<-stationary();data.frame(State=c("High","Moderate","Low"),Probability=round(s,4),Percentage=paste0(round(s*100,1),"%"))})
  output$stationary_plot <- renderPlot({s<-stationary();barplot(s,names.arg=c("High","Moderate","Low"),ylim=c(0,1),ylab="Long-run probability",xlab="Productivity state");grid(nx=NA,ny=NULL)})
  simulated <- eventReactive(input$run_simulation, {
    states <- c("High","Moderate","Low")
    current <- if(length(daily_states()) == 0) 2 else match(tail(daily_states(),1), states)
    result <- character(input$sim_days)

    for (i in 1:input$sim_days) {
      current <- sample(1:3, 1, prob=P()[current, ])
      result[i] <- states[current]
    }

    result
  })
  output$simulation_plot <- renderPlot({req(simulated());y<-match(simulated(),c("Low","Moderate","High"));plot(y,type="s",ylim=c(1,3),yaxt="n",xlab="Future day",ylab="Productivity");axis(2,at=1:3,labels=c("Low","Moderate","High"));grid()})
  output$simulation_table <- renderTable({req(simulated());counts<-table(factor(simulated(),levels=c("High","Moderate","Low")));data.frame(State=names(counts),Days=as.numeric(counts),Percentage=paste0(round(counts/length(simulated())*100,1),"%"))})

  output$total_problems <- renderText({d<-data_store();if(nrow(d)==0)"0" else sum(d$Problems_Attempted,na.rm=TRUE)})
  output$overall_accuracy <- renderText({d<-data_store();if(nrow(d)==0)"-" else {a<-sum(d$Problems_Attempted,na.rm=TRUE);c<-sum(d$Problems_Correct,na.rm=TRUE);if(a==0)"-" else paste0(round(c/a*100,1),"%")}})
  output$avg_mock_score <- renderText({d<-data_store();if(nrow(d)==0)"-" else {s<-d$Mock_Score[!is.na(d$Mock_Score)];if(length(s)==0)"-" else paste0(round(mean(s),1),"%")}})
  output$total_study_hours <- renderText({d<-data_store();if(nrow(d)==0)"0 h" else paste0(round(sum(d$Study_Hours,na.rm=TRUE),1)," h")})
  output$streak <- renderText({d<-data_store();if(nrow(d)==0)"0 days" else {dates<-sort(unique(d$Date));today<-Sys.Date();streak<-0;for(x in rev(dates)){if(x==today-streak)streak<-streak+1 else if(x<today-streak)break};paste0(streak," day",ifelse(streak==1,"","s"))}})

  output$accuracy_plot <- renderPlot({d<-data_store();d<-d[!is.na(d$Problems_Attempted)&d$Problems_Attempted>0,];if(nrow(d)==0){plot.new();text(.5,.5,"No problem performance data recorded yet.");return()};d<-d[order(d$Date),];acc<-d$Problems_Correct/d$Problems_Attempted*100;plot(d$Date,acc,type="o",pch=19,lwd=2,ylim=c(0,100),xlab="Date",ylab="Accuracy (%)");grid()})

  output$countdown_summary <- renderUI({d<-countdown_data();target_total<-input$exam_length_hours*input$hours_per_exam_hour;hours_logged<-sum(d$Study_Hours,na.rm=TRUE);hours_remaining<-max(target_total-hours_logged,0);days_remaining<-as.numeric(as.Date(input$exam_date)-Sys.Date());if(days_remaining<=0)div(class="status-low",h3("Exam date has passed or is today.")) else {required_pace<-hours_remaining/days_remaining;recent <- d[order(d$Date), , drop=FALSE]
    if (nrow(recent) > 0) {
      recent_daily <- aggregate(Study_Hours ~ Date, data=recent, FUN=sum, na.rm=TRUE)
      recent_daily <- tail(recent_daily[order(recent_daily$Date), , drop=FALSE], 14)
      recent_pace <- mean(recent_daily$Study_Hours, na.rm=TRUE)
    } else {

    }
    on_pace <- recent_pace >= required_pace;div(class=if(on_pace)"status-high" else "status-moderate",div(class="countdown-number",paste0(days_remaining)),p("days remaining"),p(paste0("Target: ",round(target_total,0)," total study hours.")),p(paste0("Logged: ",round(hours_logged,1)," h · Remaining: ",round(hours_remaining,1)," h.")),p(paste0("Required: ",round(required_pace,2)," h/day · Recent: ",round(recent_pace,2)," h/day")))}})

  output$pace_plot <- renderPlot({d<-countdown_data();if(nrow(d)==0){plot.new();text(.5,.5,"No logged study sessions found.");return()};d<-aggregate(Study_Hours~Date,data=d,FUN=sum,na.rm=TRUE);d<-d[order(d$Date),];target_total<-input$exam_length_hours*input$hours_per_exam_hour;hours_remaining<-max(target_total-sum(d$Study_Hours),0);days_remaining<-max(as.numeric(as.Date(input$exam_date)-Sys.Date()),1);required_pace<-hours_remaining/days_remaining;barplot(d$Study_Hours,names.arg=format(d$Date,"%d %b"),las=2,ylab="Study hours",ylim=c(0,max(c(d$Study_Hours,required_pace))*1.2));abline(h=required_pace,lty=2,lwd=2);grid(nx=NA,ny=NULL)})

  observeEvent(input$scenario_preset,{preset<-scenario_presets[[input$scenario_preset]];if(!is.null(preset$extra_study)){updateSliderInput(session,"extra_study",value=preset$extra_study);updateSliderInput(session,"less_distraction",value=preset$less_distraction);updateSliderInput(session,"extra_sleep",value=preset$extra_sleep);updateSliderInput(session,"better_focus",value=preset$better_focus)}})
  output$scenario_preset_desc <- renderUI({p(class="small-note",scenario_presets[[input$scenario_preset]]$desc)})
  improved_P <- reactive({
    base <- P()

    improvement <- input$extra_study * 0.025 +
      input$less_distraction * 0.035 +
      input$extra_sleep * 0.020 +
      input$better_focus * 0.025

    transfer <- function(row, from, to, amount) {
      amount <- min(max(amount, 0), row[from])
      row[from] <- row[from] - amount
      row[to] <- row[to] + amount
      row
    }

    new_P <- base

    # Scenario assumption: improvements shift probability mass away from Low
    # toward High/Moderate while preserving each row sum exactly.
    new_P[1, ] <- transfer(base[1, ], from=3, to=1, amount=improvement)
    new_P[2, ] <- transfer(base[2, ], from=3, to=1, amount=improvement * 0.8)
    new_P[3, ] <- transfer(base[3, ], from=3, to=2, amount=improvement * 0.5)

    new_P
  })

  output$scenario_message <- renderUI({current<-stationary_distribution(P());improved<-stationary_distribution(improved_P());change<-(improved[1]-current[1])*100;div(class="scenario-box",h3("🌱 What does this mean?"),p(paste0("Current long-run High productivity probability: ",round(current[1]*100,1),"%.")),p(paste0("Under this scenario: ",round(improved[1]*100,1),"%.")),h4(paste0("Estimated change: ",ifelse(change>=0,"+",""),round(change,1)," percentage points.")))})

Set an exam target to begin."));latest<-tail(d[order(d$Date,d$Entry_ID),],1);div(span(class="tag",latest$Exam),span(class="tag",latest$State),h3(latest$Topic,style="margin-top:13px;"),p(paste0("Latest session: ",latest$Study_Hours," focused hours.")))})

  output$today_snapshot <- renderUI({d<-data_store();if(nrow(d)==0)return(div(class="empty-state","No sessions logged today."));d<-d[d$Date==Sys.Date(),,drop=FALSE];if(nrow(d)==0)return(div(class="empty-state","No sessions logged today."));div(h3(paste0(round(sum(d$Study_Hours,na.rm=TRUE),1)," h")),p(paste0(nrow(d)," session",ifelse(nrow(d)==1,"","s")," across ",length(unique(d$Exam))," exam",ifelse(length(unique(d$Exam))==1,"","s"),".")),p(class="small-note",paste(unique(d$Topic),collapse=" · ")))})

  output$download <- downloadHandler(filename=function(){"actuarial_study_history.csv"},content=function(file){write.csv(data_store(),file,row.names=FALSE,na="")})
